source.note: From AMU Cloud (amucloud.in, now offline), a student-run site of Drive folders. B.Tech Electronics Engineering, 2nd year: Circuit Theory, Electronic Devices & Circuits, Logic Circuits, Maths 1 and Maths 2 (the 2nd-year Higher Mathematics courses), Signals and Systems. Each has Unit folders, PYQ, Extra Material, Tutorial Sheets and Assignment folders.
